before.name: James Victory
before.description: James Victory was a Black worker of Detroit framed on a robbery charge in a 1934 case the ILD publicized as a "northern Scottsboro"; a mass defense won his acquittal.

credit: Photographer unknown; Labor Defender, September 1934, published by International Labor Defense; reproduced by Revolution's Newsstand. Cropped.
rights: Rights not established; no public-domain or permission claim. User authorized verified portraits with uncertain usage rights.
identity_verification: Original scan caption explicitly names James Victory and says freed by Detroit ILD defense campaign. Contemporary Harry Haywood speech describes same Detroit robbery frame-up, supporting identity independently of caption.
